'];
function prof(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PK)||'null')}catch(e){return null}}
function settingsObj(){try{return Object.assign({music:true,voice:true,fx:true},JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SETK)||'{}'))}catch(e){return {music:true,voice:true,fx:true}}}
Object.assign(state,settingsObj());
function showHome(){document.getElementById('internal').classList.remove('on');document.getElementById('home').classList.add('on')}
function shell(title,body){home.classList.remove('on');internal.classList.add('on');internal.innerHTML=`<div class="panel"><h2>${title}</h2>${body}</div>`}
function enterGame(dest){startMusic();if(!prof()){afterReg=dest;register.classList.add('on');return} route(dest)}
function route(x){if(x==='quiz')quizMenu();else if(x==='challenges')challenges();else caseView()}
function toggleVet(){vetfields.style.display=(rc.value==='vet'||rc.value==='dpi')?'block':'none'}
function saveProfile(){let o={name:rn.value.trim(),cat:rc.value,crmv:rcrmv.value.trim(),uf:ruf.value.trim().toUpperCase()};if(!o.name||!o.cat||((o.cat==='vet'||o.cat==='dpi')&&(!o.crmv||o.uf.length!==2))){regerr.textContent='Complete os campos obrigatórios.';return}if(o.cat==='academic'){o.crmv='';o.uf=''}localStorage.setItem(PK,JSON.stringify(o));register.classList.remove('on');let d=afterReg;afterReg=null;if(d)route(d)}
function profile(){let p=prof();if(!p){afterReg=null;register.classList.add('on');return}shell('MEU PERFIL',`<p><b>${p.name}</b></p><p class="muted">${p.cat==='academic'?'Acadêmico de Medicina Veterinária':p.cat==='dpi'?'Médico-veterinário — Diagnóstico por Imagem':'Médico-veterinário — outras áreas'}${p.crmv?'<br>CRMV '+p.crmv+' / '+p.uf:''}</p><button class="btn" onclick="editProfile()">EDITAR PERFIL</button>`)}
function editProfile(){let p=prof();rn.value=p.name;rc.value=p.cat;rcrmv.value=p.crmv||'';ruf.value=p.uf||'';toggleVet();register.classList.add('on')}
function settings(){shell('CONFIGURAÇÕES',`<label><input type="checkbox" ${state.music?'checked':''} onchange="setOpt('music',this.checked)"> Música</label><br><label><input type="checkbox" ${state.voice?'checked':''} onchange="setOpt('voice',this.checked)"> Voz</label><br><label><input type="checkbox" ${state.fx?'checked':''} onchange="setOpt('fx',this.checked)"> Efeitos</label><button class="btn" onclick="testAV()">TESTAR SOM E EFEITOS</button><p class="muted">Ao tocar em testar, deve tocar música, voz e efeito visual.</p>`)}
function setOpt(k,v){state[k]=v;localStorage.setItem(SETK,JSON.stringify({music:state.music,voice:state.voice,fx:state.fx}));if(k==='music'){v?startMusic():bgm.pause()}}
function testAV(){startMusic();partyFx(true);speak('Desafio DPI. Aqui o plantão vira jogo.')}
function startMusic(){if(!state.music)return;if(bgm.paused){bgm.volume=.16;bgm.play().catch(()=>{})}}
bgm.addEventListener('ended',()=>{track=(track+1)%tracks.length;bgm.src=tracks[track];startMusic()})
['pointerdown','touchstart','click'].forEach(ev=>document.addEventListener(ev,startMusic,{once:true,passive:true}))
function speak(t){if(!state.voice||!('speechSynthesis'in window))return;let u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(t);u.lang='pt-BR';let old=bgm.volume;bgm.volume=.025;u.onend=()=>{bgm.volume=old};speechSynthesis.cancel();speechSynthesis.speak(u)}
function quizMenu(){shell('QUIZ DPI',`<p class="muted">Escolha o tamanho da missão.</p><button class="btn" onclick="startQuiz(10)">10 QUESTÕES</button><button class="btn" onclick="startQuiz(25)">25 QUESTÕES</button><button class="btn" onclick="startQuiz(50)">50 QUESTÕES</button>`)}
function startQuiz(n){startMusic();state.n=n;state.i=0;state.score=0;state.qs=[...BANK].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5).slice(0,n);renderQ()}
function renderQ(){if(state.i>0 && state.i%3===0 && state.music){track=(track+1)%tracks.length;bgm.src=tracks[track];startMusic()}let q=state.qs[state.i];if(!q)return finish();bgm.volume=state.music?.075:0;let opts=[q.alternativa_a,q.alternativa_b,q.alternativa_c,q.alternativa_d];shell(`QUESTÃO ${state.i+1} / ${state.n}`,`<p class="question-text"><b>${q.pergunta}</b></p>${opts.map((o,i)=>`<button class="btn option" onclick="answer(${i},this)">${String.fromCharCode(65+i)}. ${o}</button>`).join('')}<p class="muted">Pontuação: ${state.score}</p><div class="navrow"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="confirmExit()">← VOLTAR / SAIR</button></div>`);speak(q.pergunta)}
function answer(i,el){
 let q=state.qs[state.i],correctLetter=String(q.letra_correta).toUpperCase(),ok=String.fromCharCode(65+i)===correctLetter;
 if(ok)state.score+=q.pontuacao||10;
 document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach((b,idx)=>{b.disabled=true;if(String.fromCharCode(65+idx)===correctLetter)b.classList.add('okpick')});
 if(!ok)el.classList.add('badpick');
 if(state.fx){let fx=ok?good:bad;fx.currentTime=0;fx.volume=ok?.35:.3;fx.play().catch(()=>{});if(navigator.vibrate)navigator.vibrate(ok?[30,30,55]:80)}
 let exp=(q.explicacao||q.dica||''), msg=pickFeedback(ok);
 document.querySelectorAll('#internal .panel .navrow').forEach(nv=>nv.remove());
 let box=document.createElement('div');box.className='feedback '+(ok?'ok ':'no ')+('variant'+(1+Math.floor(Math.random()*3)));
 box.innerHTML=`<span class="stamp">${ok?['✓','★','🐾'][Math.floor(Math.random()*3)]:['✕','↻','!'][Math.floor(Math.random()*3)]}</span><strong>${msg[0]}</strong><p>${msg[1]}</p><p>${exp}</p><div class="navrow"><button class="btn" onclick="nextQuestion()">PRÓXIMO →</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="confirmExit()">← SAIR</button></div>`;
 document.querySelector('#internal .panel').appendChild(box);
 livelyFx(ok);
}
function nextQuestion(){state.i++;renderQ()}
function confirmExit(){if(confirm('Deseja sair desta missão? Seu progresso desta rodada será encerrado.'))showHome()}
function partyFx(ok){if(!state.fx)return;party.innerHTML=`<div class="react">${ok?'👍':'💥'}</div>`;if(ok){for(let i=0;i<34;i++){let c=document.createElement('i');c.className='confetti';c.style.left=Math.random()*100+'vw';c.style.background=`hsl(${Math.random()*360} 90% 60%)`;c.style.setProperty('--dx',(Math.random()*90-45)+'px');party.appendChild(c)}for(let i=0;i<3;i++){let f=document.createElement('i');f.className='firework';f.style.left=(20+Math.random()*60)+'vw';f.style.top=(18+Math.random()*45)+'vh';party.appendChild(f)}good.currentTime=0;good.volume=.35;good.play().catch(()=>{})}else{bad.currentTime=0;bad.volume=.3;bad.play().catch(()=>{})}if(navigator.vibrate)navigator.vibrate(ok?[30,30,55]:80);setTimeout(()=>party.innerHTML='',1700)}
function finish(){bgm.volume=.16;let p=prof(),a=[];try{a=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SK)||'[]')}catch(e){}a.push({name:p.name,cat:p.cat,score:state.score,date:Date.now()});localStorage.setItem(SK,JSON.stringify(a));shell('MISSÃO CONCLUÍDA',`<h2>${state.score} pontos</h2><button class="btn" onclick="quizMenu()">JOGAR NOVAMENTE</button>`);partyFx(true)}
function scores(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SK)||'[]')}catch(e){return[]}}
function ranking(){let a=scores(),cats=[['academic','ACADÊMICOS'],['vet','MÉDICOS-VETERINÁRIOS — OUTRAS ÁREAS'],['dpi','DIAGNÓSTICO POR IMAGEM']];shell('RANKING',cats.map(c=>`<h3>${c[1]}</h3>${a.filter(x=>x.cat===c[0]).sort((x,y)=>y.score-x.score).slice(0,5).map((x,i)=>`<p>${i+1}. ${x.name} — ${x.score} pts</p>`).join('')||'<p class="muted">Sem resultados ainda.</p>'}`).join(''))}
function bankView(){shell('BANCO',`<h2>${BANK.length}</h2><p class="muted">questões carregadas no banco oficial do protótipo.</p>`)}
function challenges(){shell('DESAFIOS DPI',`<p class="muted">Escolha uma missão. Cada desafio tem uma mecânica diferente.</p><button class="btn" onclick="miniLightning()">⚡ RELÂMPAGO</button><button class="btn" onclick="miniTarget()">🎯 ALVO</button><button class="btn" onclick="miniElimination()">✂ ELIMINAÇÃO</button><button class="btn" onclick="miniAssociation()">🔗 ASSOCIAÇÃO</button><button class="btn" onclick="miniHangman()">🔤 FORCA</button><button class="btn" onclick="miniCrossword()">▦ PALAVRAS CRUZADAS</button><button class="btn" onclick="miniDiagnosis()">🩺 FECHE O DIAGNÓSTICO</button><div class="navrow"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="showHome()">← VOLTAR</button></div>`)}
function miniNav(){return `<div class="navrow"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="challenges()">← DESAFIOS</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="showHome()">SAIR</button></div>`}
function stripAcc(s){return (s||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'')}
function normWord(s){return stripAcc(s).toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g,'')}
const MK='dpiMissionsV1';
function missions(){try{return Object.assign({count:0,xp:0,streak:0,best:0},JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(MK)||'{}'))}catch(e){return {count:0,xp:0,streak:0,best:0}}}
function trackMission(ok,pts){let m=missions();m.count++;m.xp+=ok?(pts||15):5;m.streak=ok?m.streak+1:0;m.best=Math.max(m.best,m.streak);localStorage.setItem(MK,JSON.stringify(m));return m}
function miniResult(ok,title,detail,pts){let m=trackMission(ok,pts);livelyFx(ok);let msg=pickFeedback(ok);let gained=ok?(pts||15):5;let streakNote=(ok&&m.streak>=3&&m.streak%3===0)?`<p>🔥 Sequência de ${m.streak}! Bônus de combo.</p>`:'';let box=document.createElement('div');box.className='feedback '+(ok?'ok ':'no ')+('variant'+(1+Math.floor(Math.random()*3)));box.innerHTML=`<span class="stamp">${ok?['✓','★','🐾'][Math.floor(Math.random()*3)]:['✕','↻','!'][Math.floor(Math.random()*3)]}</span><strong>${title||msg[0]}</strong><p>${msg[1]}</p><p>${detail||''}</p><p class="muted">+${gained} XP</p>${streakNote}${miniNav()}`;document.querySelector('#internal .panel').appendChild(box)}
let miniTimer=null;
function miniLightning(){let q=BANK[Math.floor(Math.random()*BANK.length)],opts=[q.alternativa_a,q.alternativa_b,q.alternativa_c,q.alternativa_d],t=8;window._lgQ=q;shell('⚡ RELÂMPAGO',`<div class="miniStage"><div class="miniTitle">DECIDA EM <span id="lgTime">${t}</span>s</div><p>${q.pergunta}</p>${opts.map((o,i)=>`<button class="btn option" onclick="lgAnswer(${i})">${String.fromCharCode(65+i)}. ${o}</button>`).join('')}</div>`);clearInterval(miniTimer);miniTimer=setInterval(()=>{t--;let el=document.getElementById('lgTime');if(el)el.textContent=t;if(t<=0){clearInterval(miniTimer);lgAnswer(-1)}},1000)}
function lgAnswer(i){clearInterval(miniTimer);document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(b=>b.disabled=true);let q=window._lgQ,correctLetter=String(q.letra_correta).toUpperCase(),ok=i>=0&&String.fromCharCode(65+i)===correctLetter;if(i>=0)document.querySelectorAll('.option')[i].classList.add(ok?'okpick':'badpick');miniResult(ok,i<0?'TEMPO ESGOTADO':'',q.explicacao||q.dica||'')}
function miniTarget(){let q=BANK[Math.floor(Math.random()*BANK.length)],letters=['A','B','C','D'],pos=letters.map(()=>({top:8+Math.random()*68,left:6+Math.random()*70}));window._tgQ=q;shell('🎯 ALVO',`<div class="miniStage"><p>${q.pergunta}</p><div style="position:relative;height:210px;border:1px dashed #23d7f255;border-radius:14px;margin-top:8px">${letters.map((l,i)=>`<button onclick="tgAnswer(${i})" style="position:absolute;top:${pos[i].top}%;left:${pos[i].left}%;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0a8b8b,#00a76c);color:#fff;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 0 16px #23d7f299">${l}</button>`).join('')}</div><p class="miniHelp">Toque no alvo com a decisão correta.</p></div>`)}
function tgAnswer(i){document.querySelectorAll('.miniStage button[onclick^="tgAnswer"]').forEach(b=>b.disabled=true);let q=window._tgQ,correctLetter=String(q.letra_correta).toUpperCase(),ok=String.fromCharCode(65+i)===correctLetter;miniResult(ok,'',q.explicacao||q.dica||'')}
function miniElimination(){let q=BANK[Math.floor(Math.random()*BANK.length)],o=[q.alternativa_a,q.alternativa_b,q.alternativa_c,q.alternativa_d];window._elQ=q;window._elWrong=0;shell('✂ ELIMINAÇÃO',`<div class="miniStage"><p>${q.pergunta}</p><p class="miniHelp">Elimine as alternativas incorretas até restar apenas a certa.</p>${o.map((x,i)=>`<button class="btn option" onclick="elPick(${i},this)">${String.fromCharCode(65+i)}. ${x}</button>`).join('')}</div>`)}
function elPick(i,el){let q=window._elQ,correctLetter=String(q.letra_correta).toUpperCase(),isCorrect=String.fromCharCode(65+i)===correctLetter;if(isCorrect){document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(b=>b.disabled=true);el.classList.add('badpick');miniResult(false,'ELIMINOU A CERTA',q.explicacao||q.dica||'');return}el.disabled=true;el.style.opacity=.25;el.classList.add('badpick');window._elWrong++;if(window._elWrong>=3){document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(b=>{if(!b.disabled)b.classList.add('okpick')});miniResult(true,'',q.explicacao||q.dica||'')}}
function miniAssociation(){let qs=[...BANK].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5).slice(0,4);window._asQs=qs;window._asSel={left:null,right:null};window._asMatched=0;let left=qs.map((q,i)=>({i,label:q.tema}));let right=[...qs].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5).map(q=>({id:q.id,label:(q.resposta_correta_extenso||'').slice(0,42)+'…'}));shell('🔗 ASSOCIAÇÃO',`<div class="miniStage"><p class="miniHelp">Associe o tema à decisão correta correspondente.</p><div class="assocgrid">${left.map(l=>`<button class="btn asL" data-i="${l.i}" onclick="asPickL(${l.i},this)">${l.label}</button>`).join('')}${right.map(r=>`<button class="btn asR" data-id="${r.id}" onclick="asPickR('${r.id}',this)">${r.label}</button>`).join('')}</div><p class="miniHelp" id="asProg">0/4 pares</p></div>`)}
function asPickL(i,el){document.querySelectorAll('.asL').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('selected'));el.classList.add('selected');window._asSel.left=i;asCheck()}
function asPickR(id,el){document.querySelectorAll('.asR').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('selected'));el.classList.add('selected');window._asSel.right=id;asCheck()}
function asCheck(){let s=window._asSel;if(s.left===null||s.right===null)return;let q=window._asQs[s.left],ok=q.id===s.right,lEl=document.querySelector(`.asL[data-i="${s.left}"]`),rEl=document.querySelector(`.asR[data-id="${s.right}"]`);if(ok){lEl.disabled=true;rEl.disabled=true;lEl.classList.add('okpick');rEl.classList.add('okpick');window._asMatched++;document.getElementById('asProg').textContent=window._asMatched+'/4 pares';if(window._asMatched>=4)miniResult(true,'','Todos os pares corretos foram associados.')}else{lEl.classList.add('badpick');rEl.classList.add('badpick');setTimeout(()=>{lEl.classList.remove('selected','badpick');rEl.classList.remove('selected','badpick')},500)}window._asSel={left:null,right:null}}
function wordPool(){return [...new Set(BANK.map(q=>normWord(q.subtema||q.tema)))].filter(w=>w.length>=4&&w.length<=10)}
function clueFor(word){let cands=BANK.filter(x=>normWord(x.subtema||x.tema)===word);for(let q of cands){for(let c of [q.dica,q.limitacao_clinica]){if(c&&!stripAcc(c).toUpperCase().includes(word))return c}}return ''}
function miniHangman(){let p=wordPool();window._hgWord=p[Math.floor(Math.random()*p.length)];window._hgClue=clueFor(window._hgWord);window._hgGuessed=new Set();window._hgWrong=0;hgRender()}
function hgRender(){let word=window._hgWord,guessed=window._hgGuessed,wrong=window._hgWrong,display=[...word].map(c=>guessed.has(c)?c:'_').join(' '),letters='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.split('');shell('🔤 FORCA',`<div class="miniStage"><p class="miniHelp">🔎 Pista: ${window._hgClue||'termo do banco oficial DPI.'}</p><p class="miniHelp">Erros: ${wrong}/6</p><div class="hangword">${display}</div><div class="assocgrid">${letters.map(l=>`<button class="btn" ${guessed.has(l)?'disabled':''} onclick="hgGuess('${l}')">${l}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>`)}
function hgGuess(l){let word=window._hgWord;window._hgGuessed.add(l);if(!word.includes(l))window._hgWrong++;if([...word].every(c=>window._hgGuessed.has(c))){miniResult(true,'',`O tema era: ${word}`);return}if(window._hgWrong>=6){miniResult(false,'',`O tema era: ${word}`);return}hgRender()}
function miniCrossword(){let pool=wordPool(),a=pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)],rest=pool.filter(w=>w!==a).sort(()=>Math.random()-.5),b=null,ai=-1,bi=-1;for(let cand of rest){let found=false;for(let i=0;i<a.length&&!found;i++)for(let j=0;j<cand.length&&!found;j++)if(a[i]===cand[j]){ai=i;bi=j;b=cand;found=true}if(found)break}window._cw={a,b,ai,bi};let clueA=clueFor(a),clueB=b?clueFor(b):'';let html='';if(b){let w=a.length,h=b.length,cells=[];for(let r=0;r<h;r++)for(let c=0;c<w;c++){if(c===ai||r===bi){let ans=r===bi?a[c]:b[r];cells.push(`<input maxlength="1" class="cwcell" data-ans="${ans}" style="grid-column:${c+1};grid-row:${r+1};width:26px;height:26px;text-align:center;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #23d7f2;background:#052a49;color:#fff">`)}}html+=`<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(${w},26px);gap:2px">${cells.join('')}</div>`}else{html+=`<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(${a.length},26px);gap:2px">${[...a].map((ch,i)=>`<input maxlength="1" class="cwcell" data-ans="${ch}" style="grid-column:${i+1};width:26px;height:26px;text-align:center;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #23d7f2;background:#052a49;color:#fff">`).join('')}</div>`}shell('▦ PALAVRAS CRUZADAS',`<div class="miniStage"><p class="miniHelp">🔎 Pista A: ${clueA||'termo do banco oficial DPI.'}</p>${b?`<p class="miniHelp">🔎 Pista B: ${clueB||'termo do banco oficial DPI.'}</p>`:''}${html}<button class="btn" onclick="cwCheck()">VERIFICAR</button></div>`)}
function cwCheck(){let ok=[...document.querySelectorAll('.cwcell')].every(inp=>(inp.value||'').toUpperCase()===inp.dataset.ans);miniResult(ok,'',window._cw.b?`Termos: ${window._cw.a} / ${window._cw.b}`:`Termo: ${window._cw.a}`)}
function miniDiagnosis(){let q=BANK[Math.floor(Math.random()*BANK.length)];window._dgQ=q;window._dgStage=0;dgRender()}
function dgRender(){let q=window._dgQ,stage=window._dgStage,clues=[q.dica,q.limitacao_clinica].filter(Boolean),maxClue=clues.length;if(stage<maxClue){let shown=clues.slice(0,stage+1).map((c,i)=>`<p>🔎 Pista ${i+1}: ${c}</p>`).join('');shell('🩺 FECHE O DIAGNÓSTICO',`<div class="miniStage"><p><b>${q.pergunta}</b></p>${shown}<button class="btn" onclick="dgNext()">PRÓXIMA PISTA</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="dgDecide()">JÁ SEI — DECIDIR</button></div>`)}else{window._dgUsed=Math.min(stage,maxClue);let shown=clues.map((c,i)=>`<p>🔎 Pista ${i+1}: ${c}</p>`).join(''),opts=[q.alternativa_a,q.alternativa_b,q.alternativa_c,q.alternativa_d];shell('🩺 FECHE O DIAGNÓSTICO',`<div class="miniStage"><p><b>${q.pergunta}</b></p>${shown}${opts.map((o,i)=>`<button class="btn option" onclick="dgAnswer(${i})">${String.fromCharCode(65+i)}. ${o}</button>`).join('')}</div>`)}}
function dgNext(){window._dgStage++;dgRender()}
function dgDecide(){window._dgStage=999;dgRender()}
function dgAnswer(i){document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(b=>b.disabled=true);let q=window._dgQ,correctLetter=String(q.letra_correta).toUpperCase(),ok=String.fromCharCode(65+i)===correctLetter,used=window._dgUsed||0,note=ok&&used===0?'Fechado com poucas pistas — diagnóstico preciso!':'';miniResult(ok,'',(q.explicacao||'')+(note?' '+note:''))}
function caseView(){shell('FECHAR O CASO',`<p><b>Um paciente. Dez decisões. Um diagnóstico final.</b></p><p class="muted">Estrutura clínica será preenchida somente com casos validados.</p><button class="btn" onclick="caseStep(1)">INICIAR DEMONSTRAÇÃO</button>`)}
function caseStep(n){shell('FECHAR O CASO',`<p>ETAPA ${n} DE 10</p><div style="height:9px;border-radius:9px;background:#03243f"><i style="display:block;width:${n*10}%;height:100%;background:#62ef42;border-radius:9px"></i></div><p class="muted">Fluxo funcional demonstrativo, sem inventar conteúdo clínico.</p>${n<10?`<button class="btn" onclick="caseStep(${n+1})">PRÓXIMA DECISÃO</button>`:'<button class="btn" onclick="achievements()">CONCLUIR</button>'}`)}
function achievements(){let a=scores(),m=missions(),bestQuiz=a.length?Math.max(...a.map(x=>x.score)):0,totalMissions=a.length+m.count;shell('MINHAS CONQUISTAS',`<h2>🏅 ${totalMissions} missões</h2><p>🎯 Quiz: ${a.length} rodadas · melhor pontuação <b>${bestQuiz}</b></p><p>⚡ Desafios: ${m.count} concluídos · <b>${m.xp}</b> XP</p><p>🔥 Sequência atual: ${m.streak} · recorde: ${m.best}</p><button class="btn" onclick="partyFx(true)">🎉 COMEMORAR</button>`)}
</script></body></html>
